name: Makera Carvera Air with 4th axis

sources.note: Fusion 360 machine 'Makera Carvera Air 4-axis Community Version 1.4.6': A about +X, 4000 mm/min, feed mode DPM combination. No travel or spindle limits in the file.
work area 300 x 200 x 130 mm, 4th axis 92 mm diameter x 200 mm, 200 W spindle 0-13000 rpm (harmonic-drive 4th axis)

Carvera firmware: on G1/G2/G3 with A, F is mm/min of surface at a radius estimated from the work Y and Z; pure-A moves convert F through that circumference; G0 is not limited this way. Stock firmware adds 30 mm to the diameter and caps the rotary at 5 RPM.
Community firmware 2.1.0c drops the 5 RPM cap for the configured rate (about 6.6 RPM on the harmonic-drive 4th axis) and the +30 mm padding

post.name: Makera Carvera Air with 4th axis
post.origin_comment: Zero: X0 front face, Y0/Z0 rotation axis, A rotates about X
post.reset_rotary: G92 A0 (re-zero A here so the profile job's rotations don't unwind)
post.tool_change: M6 T{tool} (tool change + tool length measurement)

notes: A community guide gives the Air spindle as 3000-13000 rpm; Makera's page says 0-13000.
The Fusion file declares a 6-tool changer; the Air changes tools by hand (quick change), so this profile uses manual.

Feeds with A follow the stock Makera firmware (surface speed, radius + 15 mm, A at most 5 RPM = 1800 deg/min). For the community firmware 2.1.0c set surface_radius_pad to 0 and the A max_feed to 2376 (6.6 RPM).
